#478 · Snow Land Pokémon

Froslass

Ice Ghost

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Froslass is an Ice/Ghost-type Snow Land Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 1.3 m tall and weighs 26.6 kg. It evolves from Snorunt. Its highest base stat is Speed (110), with a base stat total of 480.
